title: Sidemen on the Bald Head session and the young players he trained
summary: Longhair recalls the young musicians he trained, such as Robert Parker on sax and a drummer named Al, and the songs Bald Head and Mardi Gras they did.

story.theme_name: Charlie Parker, Dizzy and the bebop revolution
story.community_name: Playing with and understanding Thelonious Monk

blocks.x: Yeah, he'd be... Not too long ago, he played harmonica with his guitar's pop. Yeah, yeah. We never met him though. No, I never had met him. Never had met him. When were you born, Roy? I was born in 1918. 1918? December 19th. December 19th? And who... Can you remember who your side men were on your session with the bald head?
Bald head? Yeah, I had little Robert Parker. The one that was doing bad for the 90s. They were mostly kids, but I was training them at that time.
Yeah. And I... He playing guitar? No, he was playing sax. Playing saxophone? Yeah.

But at them times he was learning. But I thought they'd done well enough to record with, you know, between myself.
